title: Amén
lyrics_plain:
Arranged by Alan LokFrom The Clubhouse BBS - (416)754-2556This song may be used for non-commercial purposes only.Disassembly of this song is strictly prohibited!I'm Not Saying A Word - CP000021Arranged by Alan Lok(C)1995 Clubhouse Productions - All Rights ReservedFrom The Clubhouse BBS - (416)754-2556This song may be used for non-commercial purposes only.Disassembly of this song is strictly prohibited!
If I could stand inside his shoes I'd say,
how can I compare the to a summers day.
I'd take a page in all the papers,
I'd anounce it on the news
if I was the guy, if I was in his shoes.
If I was him I'd bring you flowers
and ask you to dance;
we'd while away the hours making future plans
for rainy days in country lanes and trips to the sea
I'd just tell you that I love you if it was me.
But I'm not saying a word.
I'm not saying I care
though I would like you to know
that I'm not saying a word.
I'm not saying I care,
though I would like you to know.
If I was him I'd have to tell you,
what I've kept in my heart,
that even if we had to live some worlds apart,
there would not be a day in which I'd not think of you.
If I was him, if I was him
that's what I'd do.
But I'm not saying a word,
I'm not saying I care,
though I would like you to know
that I'm not saying a word,
I'm not saying I care
though I would like you to know.
